Carried by Black Lizalfos seasoned in battle.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 35 |durability = 27 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Lizal Tri-Boomerang}} Lizal Tri-Boomerangs are [[Boomerang]]s with three blades that are typically carried by [[Black Lizalfos]]. They are also used by [[Silver Lizalfos]], [[Golden Lizalfos]], [[Fire-Breath Lizalfos]], [[Ice-Breath Lizalfos]], and [[Electric Lizalfos]]. They can be thrown to attack [[Enemy|Enemies]] at a range, but they must be caught before returning to [[Link]] or else he will take damage. Alternatively, they can be used as melee [[Weapon]]s. These Boomerangs are part of the [[Lizalfos Gear]] equipment archetype.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} They are commonly found in the [[Hebra Mountains]] and the [[Akkala Highlands]]. As metallic Weapons, Lizal Tri-Boomerangs will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] when equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s. They can also be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]] on the [[Sheikah Slate]], but they will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Sword_009" |Life = 27 |Power = 36 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = true |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = false |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 6 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 12 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 6 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 13 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 24 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 14 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.0 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 1.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.0 |ThrowRotSpeed = 1500.0 |SellingPrice = 30 |BuyingPrice = 69 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link One-Handed Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Lizal Tri-Boomerang Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for the Lizal Tri-Boomerang ==See Also== {{See Also| * Boomerang * Lizal Boomerang * Lizal Forked Boomerang * Lizalfos Gear * Weapon }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Boomerangs, Lizalfos Gear, Weapons |items= BotW, AoC }}
